Rachel (People Ops): Heads-up — we're doing a staggered deadline for the review cycle this quarter to reduce reviewer overload. ICs first, then managers a week later.
Tom (ENG Manager): Nice. timeline?
Rachel (People Ops): IC self-assessments due Mon 2026-04-06 23:59 PT. Managers' writeups due Mon 2026-04-13 23:59 PT. Calibration week: 2026-04-20 to 2026-04-24.
Maya (IC): Quick Q — I start LOA mid-cycle. Is there a special flow?
Jordan HR: Yes — if you go on LOA before manager writeups, manager should complete a provisional rating and note "LOA in progress". We'll mark as "pending final calibration". I'll DM template.
Tom (ENG Manager): Can we get a CSV export of reviewers and their assignments? makes it easier to reassign if someone is OOO.
Rachel (People Ops): Yes — we'll publish assignments CSV by EOD Friday. will include reviewer email, review links, and overflow assignee.
Maya (IC): Any help sessions? I might need support filling the form.
Rachel (People Ops): Drop-in office hours Wed 10–11am PT and Thu 4–5pm PT in #people-ops-dropins. Also short how-to doc + screenshots will be sent.
Tom (ENG Manager): For calibration, are we doing small-group raters or full-panel?
Rachel (People Ops): Small-group calibration by cohort (eng, product, research). Each cohort has 2 sessions: initial align + final signoff. We'll assign leads and a notetaker.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: review form draft window opens 72h before self-assess deadline.
Jordan HR: Heads-up for managers: if you have direct reports with cross-functional work, gather evidence/examples in the "context" field in the form — that helps calibrators.
Tom (ENG Manager): Got it. How flexible are extensions? we have a couple folks with deadline conflicts.
Rachel (People Ops): Extensions granted case-by-case. Managers can request via this form: https://rwd.company/internal/review-extension (use manager email + reason). We prefer requests 48h before the deadline.
Maya (IC): Where do we track accommodations?
Jordan HR: Please flag in the extension form and cc me. We maintain a private accommodations log.
Tom (ENG Manager): If I need to reassign a reviewer, what's the flow?
Rachel (People Ops): Email people-ops@redwood.com with reviewer to remove + replacement. We'll update assignments and re-run permission sync.
Maya (IC): small thing — can the form auto-save? I lost a draft once.
people-ops-bot: Feature note: form auto-save is enabled but only on the web app; mobile save is rolling out.
Rachel (People Ops): Action items: 1) People Ops: publish assignments CSV by Friday. 2) People Ops: post how-to + screenshots. 3) Managers: review cross-functional evidence before writeups. 4) HR: LOA template + DM to affected ICs.
Tom (ENG Manager): thanks — I'll block time for managers to write up. :thumbsup:
Maya (IC): appreciate the drop-in times. will try to make Wed slot.
Jordan HR: I'll post the LOA template here in a bit.
Rachel (People Ops): Closing note — we'll do a short anonymous survey after calibration to capture process feedback. thanks everyone. :sparkles:
